FOREWORD 


This Indian Standard was adopted bv Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized bv Avush Sectional 
Committee had been approved by the Food and Agriculture Division Council. 


Panchakarma is a unique prophylactic as well as therapeutic procedure in Ayurveda. It is advocated for the radical 
elimination of the disease causing factors and to maintain the equilibrium of the doshas. 


The fivefold measures in Panchakarma include Vamana (Emesis), Virechana (Purgation), Anuvasana Vasti (Oil enema), 
Aasthapana Vasti (Decoction enema) and Nasya (Nasal insufflation). 


Panchakarma therapy is preceded by certain preparatory procedures including Snehana (Oleation) and Swedana 
(Sudation). The Samsarjana Karma is performed as a post therapy procedure. 


Droni, a specialized table is an essential equipment used in Panchakarma procedures. 


In the formulation of this standard, due consideration has been given to the Legal Metrology Act, 2009 and Rules framed 
thereunder and the Essential Commodities Act, 1955. However, this standard is subject to restrictions imposed under these 
statutes, wherever applicable. 


The composition of the committee responsible for the formulation of this standard is given in Annex A. 


For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed 
or calculated expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS 2 : 2022 ‘Rules for 
rounding off numerical values (second revision)’. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value 
should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. 


IS 18089 (Part 1) : 2022 


Indian Standard 
PANCHAKARMA EQUIPMENT 
PART 1 DRONI — SPECIFICATIONS 


1 SCOPE 


This standard covers minimum requirements and 
dimensional details for a Droni made of wood or 
fibre. 


2 REFERENCES 


The standards listed below contain provisions 
which, through reference in this text, constitute 
provision of this standard. All standards are subject 
to revision, and parties to agreement based on this 
standard are encouraged to investigate the 
possibilitv of applving the most recent editions of 
the standards indicated: 


IS No. Title 
IS 4033 General requirements for hospital 
1968 furniture 
3 DEFINITIONS 


For the purpose of this document, the following 
terms and definitions applv: 


3.1 Bodv Part 


The part of the Droni where the trunk and limbs of 
the person rest. 


3.2 Droni 


The massaging table top. It comprises of two 
compartments — the head part and the body part. 


3.3 Droni Stand 


A tiltable table like frame with four leg piece above 
which the Droni shall be placed. 


3.4 Handles 


The rod like extensions on all the four corners of the 
Droni facilitating its transportation. 


3.5 Head Part 


The part of the Droni where the head of the person 
rests. It is to be built as a separate compartment with 
oil draining facility for facilitating various 
procedures that are confined to the head of the 
person. 


4 MATERIAL 

4.1 Framework 

As specified in 2.1 of IS 4033. 
4.2 Top 


The top of the Droni shall be made up of either 
wood or heavy duty fibre. 


4.2.1 Heart wood of any of the following trees can 
be used: 


4.2.1.1 Acacia catechu willd. 

4.2.1.2 Artocarpus integrifolia placer 
4.2.1.3 Colophyllum inophyllum Linn. 
4.2.1.4 Crateva nurvala Buch-Ham 
4.2.1.5 Ficus bengalensis Linn. 
4.2.1.6 Ficus glomerata Roxb 

4.2.1.7 Ficus lacor Ham 

4.2.1.8 Madhuca indica J. F. Gmel. 
4.2.1.9 Mangifera indica Linn. 
4.2.1.10 Pterocarpus marsupium Linn. 
4.2.1.11 Tectona grandis Linn. 


4.2.2 Heavy duty fibre of any of the following types 
can be used: 


4.2.2.1 Heavy duty fiberglass [Glass Reinforced 
Plastic (GRP) or Fibre Reinforced Plastic (FRP)] 


4.2.2.2 Polyurethane Foam (PUF) filled fibre 
4.2.2.3 Fiberglass resin

The shape and dimensions of the Droni shall be as 
per Fig. 1.

5 MANUFACTURE AND WORKMANSHIP 


5.1 The Droni Stand shall have a welded framework 
of continuous lengths of mild steel tubes as shown 
in Fig. 1. 


5.2 The four upright members shall be connected 
near the floor by a pair of longitudinal and a pair of 
transverse tubes as shown in Fig. 1. 


5.3 The upright members shall support a formed 
wooden or heavy duty fibre top having drainage 
vents at head end as well as at the foot end as shown 
in Fig. 1. 


5.4 The Droni shall have two separate compartments 
- Head part and Body part. They must have separate 
draining orifices or channels as shown in Fig. 1. 


5.5 The arrangement for joining the top and the 
upright members may be employed but the 


construction so obtained shall be sturdy and sound 
as shown in Fig. 1. 


5.6 The Droni shall be free from burrs and sharp 
edges as shown in Fig. 1. 


5.7 Coating on each part of the Droni shall be 
durable to resist discoloration, wear and corrosion. 


5.8 The material of the Droni shall be resistant to dry 
heat, resistant to wet heat, resistant of marking by 
oils and fats, resistant to marking by liquids and 
resistant to mechanical damage. 


5.9 The Droni top depth should be sloping towards 
the drainage vents as shown in Fig. 1. 


5.10 In case of a Droni made up of fibre, the top 
should be of matt finish. 


5.11 The height of the Droni shall be adjustable with 
the help of a turn wheel attached with the stand of 


IS 18089 (Part 1) : 2022 


the Droni as shown in Fig. 1. It should be able to do 
foot end or head end elevation. 


5.12 The Droni shall also confirm to the 
requirements laid down in 4.1 of IS 4033. 


6 FINISH 

As specified in 5 of IS 4033. 

7 TESTS 

7.1 Adhesion Test 

As prescribed in 6.1.1 of IS 4033. 
8 MARKING 


Each Droni shall comply with the provisions of 
clause 7.1 of IS 4033 and shall be marked with: 


a) Manufacturer’s name/trademark; 
b) Name and address of the manufacturer; 


c) Name and address of the marketer; 

d) Month and year of manufacture; 

e) Unique Device Identification/Serial 
Number; and 

f) BIS Certification Marking 


The product(s) conforming to the requirements of 
this standard may be certified as per the conformity 
assessment schemes under the provisions of the 
Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016 and the Rules 
and Regulations framed thereunder, and the 
product(s) may be marked with the Standard Mark. 


9 PACKAGING 


The Droni and its accessories shall be packed in a 
case made of a suitable material in such a way that 
they are intact in the case. It shall be so designed that 
when the Droni and accessories are kept in position 
and the lid is closed, there shall be no rattling inside 
the case. 


IS 18089 (Part 1) : 2022

Bureau of Indian Standards 


BIS is a statutory institution established under the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016 to promote harmonious 
development of the activities of standardization, marking and quality certification of goods and attending to 
connected matters in the country. 


Copyright 


BIS has the copyright of all its publications. No part of these publications may be reproduced in any form without 
the prior permission in writing of BIS. This does not preclude the free use, in the course of implementing the 
standard, of necessary details, such as symbols and sizes, type or grade designations. Enquiries relating to 
copyright be addressed to the Head (Publication & Sales), BIS. 


Review of Indian Standards 


Amendments are issued to standards as the need arises on the basis of comments. Standards are also reviewed 
periodically; a standard along with amendments is reaffirmed when such review indicates that no changes are 
needed; if the review indicates that changes are needed, it is taken up for revision. Users of Indian Standards 
should ascertain that they are in possession of the latest amendments or edition by referring to the website- 
www.bis.gov.in or www.standardsbis.
